description: The pie chart illustrates the distribution of various dialogue state attributes, with each slice representing a different attribute and its corresponding percentage of the total. The largest segment, colored light blue, corresponds to "from" and accounts for 17.00% of the total. The second largest is "to," shown in yellow, at 14.50%, followed by "genre" in dark green at 13.50%. Other notable segments include "name" (5.20%, dark brown), "size" (4.20%, medium brown), and "time" (4.10%, light green). Smaller segments include "intent" and "location" (both 3.80%, light blue and yellow respectively), "destination" (3.00%, dark green), "city" (2.60%, dark blue), "class" (2.40%, light blue), "range" (2.20%, light green), "type" (2.00%, light blue), and "beds" (1.30%, light green), with "passengers" being the smallest at 1.10% (light green). The chart uses distinct colors for each category, and the percentages are clearly labeled next to each slice, with the largest slice ("from") visually emphasized by being slightly separated from the rest.
